caveats: The Flock group-search surface is explicitly aggregated across 2006 and newer and does not time-bound either listed lobbyist to February 2026.
The surfaced Juliano profile lists registration years only through 2023, so it cannot support an active-2026 representation claim.

No native Targeted Victory, SixAM Strategies, West Shore Strategies, Dunwoody calendar production, contract, statement of work, invoice, or attributable campaign work product is added by this registry evidence.

conclusions: Issue #2112 now has a primary-record baseline for a real Georgia lobbying relationship separate from the reported Dunwoody PR-firm cluster.

The evidence should be used as a search key for year-specific 2026 registrations, expenditure/disclosure reports, and public-official communications, not as proof of a 2026 retainer or astroturf operation.
counterarguments: An aggregate search result can preserve historical associations that are not current.
A listed action group on a lobbyist profile does not by itself identify the dates, scope, payment, contacts, or activity for a particular 2026 event.
findings: Georgia's official aggregate lobbyist group search lists FLOCK GROUP INC. DBA FLOCK SAFETY with Laura Holland and Nicholas Michael Juliano.
Nicholas Michael Juliano's official Georgia lobbyist profile lists FLOCK GROUP INC. DBA FLOCK SAFETY among his action groups and shows surfaced registration years from 2016 through 2023.

The official pages establish a Georgia lobbying-registration trail but do not establish that Holland or Juliano represented Flock on February 12, 2026, attended the Dunwoody RTCC meeting, coordinated with Targeted Victory, SixAM Strategies, or West Shore Strategies, or caused any municipal or state action.
